status: Previews only; not integrated game sprites
direction: Three static pixel-art mastery levels per forge, consistent design identity; dark navy comparison sheet. LV1 base, LV2 reinforcing details, LV3 special finish.

forges.title: FORJA APRENDIZ
forges.levels: LV 1: the original humble rounded red brick furnace with crooked single chimney, gray stone arched firebox, little shovel and barrel. LV 2: SAME silhouette, add clean dark iron corner bands, repaired brighter bricks and small attached bellows. LV 3: SAME red brick oven, add bronze edge plates around the door, sturdy chimney cap, compact tool rack and hotter yellow-core orange fire. This remains visibly the humble cheapest furnace; no giant palace, gold ornament or magic.

forges.title: FORJA DO FERRO
forges.ref: TOP CENTER round gray stone furnace with iron straps and bellows
forges.levels: LV 1: original squat round gray stone furnace, single broad chimney with glowing vents, iron straps, side leather bellows and anvil. LV 2: same building and footprint, thicker iron straps, larger bronze rivets, reinforced chimney collar, small pressure valve. LV 3: same silhouette with handsome dark steel plates around its opening, upgraded double bellows, bronze valve gauges, stronger bright orange fire. Industrial blacksmith craft, no magical features.

forges.title: FORJA DOS ANÕES
forges.ref: TOP RIGHT angular bronze trimmed dwarven furnace with two chimneys
forges.levels: LV 1: original angular dark stone dwarven furnace, two equal tall chimneys, bronze angular arched doorway and geometric motifs. LV 2: same building, add bronze relief inlays, reinforced chimney bases, dwarven carved bands. LV 3: same footprint, rich bronze mechanical accents, large central engraved crest, upgraded ornate chimney caps, brighter amber fire. Clearly dwarven craftsmanship; no human faces or dragon.

forges.title: FORJA RÚNICA
forges.ref: BOTTOM LEFT dark blue magical rune furnace with blue crystals
forges.levels: LV 1: original dark blue angular stone furnace, tall central rune chimney, blue fire and small side crystal fixtures. LV 2: same building, add a few new cyan runes on stone frames and faceted larger crystals on the existing pedestals. LV 3: same footprint, refined silver trim, glowing central diamond rune and more complete bright cyan inscriptions, enhanced blue-white fire. Keep calm, legible pixel-art luminosity, no huge floating particles or glowing haze.

forges.title: FORJA DO VULCÃO
forges.ref: BOTTOM CENTER jagged black obsidian furnace with lava and chains
forges.levels: LV 1: original black obsidian furnace with jagged shoulders, central lava channel, orange firebox and iron chains. LV 2: same silhouette, add dark forged-metal reinforcements and widen existing lava cracks slightly, red-hot central diamond. LV 3: same core building, molten gold-orange veins integrated into the rock, heavier black iron trim and small lava reservoirs feeding existing side channels, very hot yellow-orange chamber. Lava remains controlled, no erupting volcano scene.

forges.title: FORJA DO DRAGÃO
forges.ref: BOTTOM RIGHT charcoal dragon-headed furnace with gold-trimmed horns
forges.levels: LV 1: original impressive dragon-headed furnace, curved horns, charcoal stone, gold bands, mouth as firebox, two side lava towers. LV 2: same recognizable dragon furnace, richer layered gold cheek armor, reinforced horns and gold trim, more detailed side towers. LV 3: SAME silhouette and footprint, finest regal gold crown plate and horn rings, tasteful deep-red small gemstone inset in forehead armor, additional gold carved dragon scales, brightest fiery orange-yellow furnace mouth and enhanced controlled side lava channels. Most magnificent furnace, but NO living dragon, NO huge wings, NO red ruby eyes; keep eyes amber.
